headline: As of 2026-11-03: 62,900,018 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 62,900,018 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,938,304), California (7,202,817), Florida (7,188,260).
